---
applyTo: "knowledge/**"
---

# Knowledge base rules

Notes are the source of truth for this repo. Question records are lean pointers into
them. A note is worth writing only if it is more accurate than the model's memory — so
every technical claim must be traceable to `docs.getdbt.com`.

## Required header

```markdown
# Incremental models

**Domain:** ae-01 — Task 1.11
**Verified:** 2026-09-29
**Concepts:** incremental, is_incremental, incremental_strategy, on_schema_change
```

- `**Domain:**` must name a domain id from `exam_config.py` and at least one task number.
  `briefing.py` parses the task numbers out of this line.
- `**Verified:**` is the date you last checked the claims against dbt docs.
  `verify_seal(deep=True)` fails a note older than 180 days.
- `**Concepts:**` is a comma-separated list of lookup keys. `build_topic_index.py`
  harvests them into `knowledge/_concepts.json`, which backs `concept_lookup`.

## Structure that the tooling reads

`briefing.py` extracts specific things by heading pattern. Use these headings so
`domain_briefing` returns study material instead of reporting the note as `thin`:

| Heading matching… | Yields |
|---|---|
| `when to`, `decision`, `cheat sheet`, `matrix`, `choosing`, `vs`, `which` | decision rules (table rows preferred over bullets) |
| `trap`, `gotcha`, `what X is not`, `common mistake` | traps |
| `why this is likely on the exam`, `exam angle` | the exam angle |

Inline `**Trap:** ...` lines are also harvested from anywhere in the note.

A note with no traps and no decision rules is reported in `needs_full_read` — it is a gap,
not a note.

## Content rules

- **Cite dbt Labs.** Link `docs.getdbt.com` pages inline as
  `[title](https://docs.getdbt.com/...)`. `build_topic_index.py` only collects sources on
  official hosts. A blog restating dbt behaviour is not a source.
- **Cache before you cite.** `cache_check` → `cache_fetch`. An uncached URL makes every
  question sourced to it fail the gate.
- **Name the version when behaviour changed.** "`data_tests:` replaced `tests:` as the
  preferred key" is a testable fact and a prime distractor.
- **Do not paraphrase config keys, flags, or YAML property names.** Exact spelling is
  exactly what is tested. Use backticks.
- **Mark uncertainty explicitly** with `> ⚠️ Unverified:` rather than smoothing it over.
- **Keep a note under ~1500 tokens.** Split by concept rather than growing one note.
- **Cross-link** with `` `other-note.md` `` or `](./other-note.md)`. The index builder
  resolves these across tracks, so an AE note can point at an Architect note.
- **Do not duplicate a shared concept across tracks.** Write it once in the track whose
  depth it belongs to and cross-link.

## Naming and location

- Path: `knowledge/<track>/<NN>-<domain-slug>/<concept-slug>.md`
- Kebab-case, singular where natural: `incremental-models.md`, `state-and-defer.md`
- `README.md` in each domain folder is generated by `scripts/bootstrap_repo.py` and
  skipped by the index builder.

## After editing

```bash
python3 scripts/build_topic_index.py
```

This regenerates `_topics.json`, `_tags.json`, and `_concepts.json`. Lookups are stale
until you do. Commit the regenerated indexes with the note.
